description: Device preferences, navigation, read-only Plane summaries, and reviewed Plane setting, Account binding, Auto-continue, Craft and Harness extension changes for the Settings window, plus read-only Plane health, one bounded disposable-storage collection, auto-delete rules with task names for their candidates, and reviewed Recovery snapshot restore and purge; approvals and snapshots name only native tokens. Local Craft files are chosen in a native dialog opened by the shell. It never receives Plane feeds or agent content, and grants no pairing, Plane, dialog, or window-core permission.
